verdict.rationale: Bruno stores collections as plain files on the user's local filesystem with no cloud sync, no account, and no vendor visibility into data (bruno-docs-8, bruno-docs-9), meaning the user has complete, direct control over retention and deletion simply by managing their own files/git history. This is reinforced by community confirmation that collections are plain text files under user-controlled git repos (bruno-comm-5, bruno-docs-14). Missing for 10: no explicit documented 'delete my data' feature or retention policy statement, and no detail on how synced secret-manager integrations (Vault, AWS, GCP) handle retention/deletion of secrets.
